messages:
Mason T: hey all, onboarding q  day 1 I'm behind our corp SOCKS proxy and want to run a short streaming smoke test. which key should I use (sandbox vs hosted), and is there a simple way to make traffic come from a stable IP for security whitelisting? also don't want my quick tests to blow up into 429 storms.

Ivy (DevEx): welcome Mason! :wave: Use a sandbox key for local/dev tests. Hosted keys are for staging/prod. Sandbox keys have lower quotas by default. Grab one at Console -> API Keys.

Ivy (DevEx): for stable egress: request access to the org devproxy forwarder (it will egress from 203.0.113.45). If you need shorter turnaround, we can also suggest running tests from a dev VM inside our dev VPC.

RateBot: FYI default sandbox = 45 req/min and 4 concurrent streaming sessions per key. Temporary test bumps accepted via infra ticket.

Mason T: does devproxy run locally or is it a hosted service? any quick run example?

Chris - Infra: two modes: local-only devproxy (runs on your laptop, still uses your IP) and org-forwarder (hosted, egresses from org IP). Quick local docker run:
```
docker run -e RW_API_KEY=sandbox_xyz -p 8080:8080 redwood/devproxy:cli
# point app at http://localhost:8080
```
To use org-forwarder, open an infra ticket and we'll give you a secure client token to route through 203.0.113.45.

Terry - Security: if you request whitelist, include the test window and owner. We prefer timeboxed access. Share the exact IP 203.0.113.45 with your security contact.

Mason T: got it. any advice to avoid rate limits while ramping? my harness spins up 50 connections fast.

Ivy (DevEx): ramp slowly, use exponential backoff + jitter, and watch X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers. For streaming, control tokens/sec rather than blindly opening many streams. If running CI, use ephemeral tokens (one per runner) to spread the load.

Chris - Infra: simple header-check example:
```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer sandbox_xyz" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream | grep -E "X-RateLimit-Remaining|Retry-After"
```
If you see Retry-After, pause that many seconds before retrying. For bigger sim loads, file an infra ticket with expected RPS and window.

Mason T: perfect  i'll try docker devproxy first, then request org-forwarder if needed. i'll also change my harness to ramp and backoff. tagging @Ivy if we need help with ephemeral CI keys.

Ivy (DevEx): happy to help. ping me the harness snippet and we can recommend batch size/token pacing. :thumbsup:
